businesses.business: Financial disclosure and compliance software and services

offering_description.value: Donnelley Financial Solutions provides financial reporting, regulatory filing and deal management tools for corporate issuers, deal advisers and investment managers. It delivers these tools through cloud platforms and helps clients prepare, file and distribute regulatory and shareholder documents.

primary_products.value: Financial reporting and SEC filing software; virtual data rooms; investment fund disclosure and reporting software

primary_services.value: Regulatory document preparation and formatting; electronic filing; printing and distribution of regulatory and shareholder materials

customer_segment.value: B2B: Public and private companies, investment banks, law firms, asset managers and investment funds

end_markets.value: Corporate financial reporting; capital markets issuance; mergers and acquisitions; investment management

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to financial reporting, regulatory filing and fund disclosure software; service fees: Document preparation, electronic filing, printing and distribution; project or contract: Virtual data rooms and disclosure services for individual capital markets transactions
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Provides tools for issuers, deal teams and fund managers to manage financial disclosures and share deal documents; service provider: Prepares, files and distributes regulatory and shareholder documents from client disclosures

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with operations in Canada, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Corporate reporting and filing, transaction data rooms, and investment fund disclosure and reporting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving issuers, deal advisers and investment managers; online: Cloud platforms for reporting, filing and secure document sharing

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC disclosure and EDGAR filing requirements shape client work, and data privacy rules govern handling of confidential records
